name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework
description: The NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF) provides guidance for organizations to manage risks associated with AI systems throughout their lifecycle. It focuses on trustworthy AI characteristics: valid, reliable, safe, secure, resilient, accountable, transparent, explainable, interpretable, privacy-enhanced, and fair. Supplemented by NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile (July 2024), which identifies 12 unique risks of generative AI systems and provides 400+ recommended actions for governing and managing GenAI-specific risks.
organization: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST)

categories.name: Govern
categories.description: Cultivate and implement a culture of risk management within organizations designing, developing, deploying, evaluating, or acquiring AI systems.

controls.name: AI Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: Establish organizational AI risk management policies, processes, procedures, and practices.

requirements.description: Legal and regulatory requirements involving AI are understood, managed, and documented.
requirements.guidance: Review AI governance policies, regulatory compliance mapping, and legal review processes.

requirements.description: AI risk tolerance is determined and documented for the organization.
requirements.guidance: Examine AI risk tolerance statements and risk appetite documentation.

requirements.description: Processes, procedures, and practices are in place to determine the needed level of risk management activities.
requirements.guidance: Review AI risk tiering methodology and assessment procedures.

requirements.description: Ongoing monitoring and periodic review of the risk management process and outcomes are planned and organizational roles and responsibilities established.
requirements.guidance: Examine AI governance committee structure, roles, and monitoring cadence.

requirements.description: Organizational policies and practices are in place to foster a critical thinking culture regarding AI risk.
requirements.guidance: Review AI ethics training, escalation procedures, and dissent mechanisms.

requirements.description: Mechanisms are in place to inventory AI systems and track risk decisions.
requirements.guidance: Examine AI system inventory, model registry, and risk decision logs.

requirements.description: Processes and procedures are in place for decommissioning AI systems safely.
requirements.guidance: Review AI decommissioning policies and data retention procedures.

controls.name: Accountability Structures
controls.description: Establish accountability structures, roles, and responsibilities for AI risk management.

requirements.description: Roles and responsibilities for AI risk management are defined and understood.
requirements.guidance: Review RACI matrix, job descriptions, and organizational charts for AI governance.

requirements.description: Mechanisms are in place to ensure accountability for AI system impacts.
requirements.guidance: Examine incident response procedures, audit trails, and escalation paths.

requirements.description: Executive leadership takes responsibility for decisions about AI system risks.
requirements.guidance: Review executive sign-off procedures and risk acceptance documentation.

controls.name: AI Workforce Diversity
controls.description: Build diverse and inclusive AI teams to enhance AI system trustworthiness.

requirements.description: Decision-making related to mapping, measuring, and managing AI risks involves diverse perspectives and teams.
requirements.guidance: Review team composition, cross-functional review processes, and diversity metrics.

requirements.description: Policies and procedures address skill gaps related to AI development and deployment.
requirements.guidance: Examine training programs, hiring practices, and competency frameworks.

controls.name: Organizational Context
controls.description: Understand the organizational context including mission, goals, and values relative to AI risk management.

requirements.description: Organizational policies and practices align AI system objectives with human values and societal benefits.
requirements.guidance: Review AI ethics policies, value statements, and societal impact assessments.

requirements.description: Organizational teams document AI system context including intended purpose, domain, and deployment environment.
requirements.guidance: Examine model cards, system documentation, and use case definitions.

requirements.description: Organizational policies address procurement and use of third-party AI systems.
requirements.guidance: Review vendor assessment procedures and third-party AI due diligence processes.

controls.name: Third-Party AI Risk
controls.description: Manage AI risks related to third-party entities throughout the AI lifecycle.

requirements.description: Policies and procedures are in place for assessing third-party AI systems and data.
requirements.guidance: Review vendor questionnaires, assessment frameworks, and due diligence checklists.

requirements.description: Contractual mechanisms address AI-specific risks with third parties.
requirements.guidance: Examine contract templates, SLAs, and AI-specific clauses.

controls.name: Stakeholder Engagement
controls.description: Engage with relevant stakeholders including affected communities in AI risk management.

requirements.description: Policies and procedures are in place for engaging with AI system stakeholders.
requirements.guidance: Review stakeholder engagement plans, feedback mechanisms, and community involvement.

requirements.description: Mechanisms exist for stakeholders to provide input on AI system development and deployment.
requirements.guidance: Examine feedback channels, public comment processes, and user testing procedures.

categories.name: Map
categories.description: Identify and categorize AI system context, capabilities, purposes, and potential impacts to inform risk management activities.

controls.name: Context and Use Case
controls.description: Establish the context and intended use of AI systems.

requirements.description: The intended purposes, potentially beneficial uses, context of use, and design specifications are documented.
requirements.guidance: Review system design documents, use case specifications, and requirements.

requirements.description: Potential positive and negative impacts of AI systems are identified and documented.
requirements.guidance: Examine impact assessments, risk registers, and benefit-risk analyses.

requirements.description: AI system functions, capabilities, and limitations are clearly documented.
requirements.guidance: Review technical specifications, model cards, and capability statements.

requirements.description: AI system goals, objectives, and constraints are defined and documented.
requirements.guidance: Examine requirements documents, design rationale, and constraint specifications.

requirements.description: The AI system is mapped to relevant AI Actor Tasks and AI lifecycle phases.
requirements.guidance: Review lifecycle documentation and actor responsibility matrices.

requirements.description: Scientific integrity and data quality standards are identified and documented.
requirements.guidance: Examine data quality policies, validation procedures, and methodology documentation.

controls.name: AI Impact Categorization
controls.description: Categorize AI systems based on potential impacts to inform risk management priorities.

requirements.description: AI system risks are identified and assessed based on potential impacts to individuals, communities, and society.
requirements.guidance: Review impact categorization methodology and risk tiering criteria.

requirements.description: Potential harms and unintended consequences of AI systems are identified and documented.
requirements.guidance: Examine harm taxonomies, consequence analyses, and risk scenarios.

requirements.description: AI system risk categorization considers frequency, severity, and reversibility of potential impacts.
requirements.guidance: Review risk scoring methodology and impact assessment criteria.

controls.name: Benefits and Costs
controls.description: Evaluate and document AI system benefits and costs to enable informed decision-making.

requirements.description: Potential benefits of the AI system are documented and weighed against potential risks.
requirements.guidance: Review benefit-cost analyses, value propositions, and risk-benefit trade-offs.

requirements.description: Decisions about AI system deployment consider effects on different populations.
requirements.guidance: Examine equity assessments and disparate impact analyses.

controls.name: Risks and Benefits over Time
controls.description: Monitor and manage evolving AI system risks and benefits throughout the lifecycle.

requirements.description: Processes are in place to continually assess AI system risks and benefits.
requirements.guidance: Review ongoing monitoring plans, reassessment schedules, and change management procedures.

requirements.description: Changes in the deployment environment or use context trigger reassessment of AI system risks.
requirements.guidance: Examine change triggers, reassessment criteria, and adaptation procedures.

controls.name: AI Actor Risks
controls.description: Identify and manage risks associated with AI actors throughout the AI lifecycle.

requirements.description: Potential negative impacts from AI actors are identified and documented.
requirements.guidance: Review actor risk assessments, insider threat considerations, and access controls.

requirements.description: Practices are in place to evaluate trustworthiness of AI actors.
requirements.guidance: Examine background check procedures, training requirements, and certification processes.

categories.name: Measure
categories.description: Analyze, assess, benchmark, and monitor AI risks and impacts, based on the AI system's context and potential impacts.

controls.name: AI Risk Assessment
controls.description: Develop and apply methodologies for measuring AI-specific risks.

requirements.description: Approaches and metrics for measuring AI system trustworthiness characteristics are identified and implemented.
requirements.guidance: Review trustworthiness metrics, measurement methodologies, and evaluation criteria.

requirements.description: Appropriate methods and metrics are used to evaluate AI system performance and safety.
requirements.guidance: Examine performance testing procedures, safety evaluations, and validation methods.

requirements.description: AI system testing and evaluation results are documented and maintained.
requirements.guidance: Review test documentation, evaluation reports, and results archives.

controls.name: Trustworthiness Evaluation
controls.description: Evaluate AI systems for trustworthiness characteristics including reliability, validity, and safety.

requirements.description: AI systems are tested for validity and reliability under expected operating conditions.
requirements.guidance: Review validation testing, reliability assessments, and robustness evaluations.

requirements.description: AI systems are evaluated for safety including fail-safe behaviors.
requirements.guidance: Examine safety testing, failure mode analysis, and contingency procedures.

requirements.description: AI systems are tested for security and resilience against attacks.
requirements.guidance: Review adversarial testing, security assessments, and resilience evaluations.

requirements.description: AI systems are evaluated for privacy risks and data protection.
requirements.guidance: Examine privacy impact assessments, data protection evaluations, and anonymization testing.

requirements.description: AI systems are evaluated for explainability and transparency.
requirements.guidance: Review explainability testing, transparency assessments, and interpretability evaluations.

requirements.description: AI systems are evaluated for fairness and bias.
requirements.guidance: Examine bias testing, fairness metrics, and disparate impact analyses.

requirements.description: AI system training data is evaluated for representativeness and quality.
requirements.guidance: Review data quality assessments, representativeness analyses, and data provenance.

requirements.description: AI models are evaluated for drift and degradation over time.
requirements.guidance: Examine model monitoring, drift detection, and performance degradation tracking.

requirements.description: Human oversight mechanisms are tested and evaluated.
requirements.guidance: Review human-in-the-loop testing, override capabilities, and escalation procedures.

requirements.description: Environmental impacts of AI systems are considered and evaluated.
requirements.guidance: Examine carbon footprint assessments, resource utilization, and sustainability metrics.

requirements.description: Safety metrics are defined and tracked for AI systems with safety implications.
requirements.guidance: Review safety KPIs, incident metrics, and harm prevention measures.

requirements.description: AI systems are evaluated in real-world or representative environments.
requirements.guidance: Examine field testing, pilot deployments, and real-world evaluation procedures.

requirements.description: Effectiveness of risk mitigation measures is evaluated.
requirements.guidance: Review mitigation effectiveness testing and control validation.

controls.name: Feedback and Monitoring
controls.description: Establish mechanisms for ongoing monitoring, feedback, and assessment of AI systems.

requirements.description: Feedback mechanisms are established for AI system stakeholders to report issues.
requirements.guidance: Review feedback channels, issue reporting procedures, and stakeholder communication.

requirements.description: AI system performance is continuously monitored in deployment.
requirements.guidance: Examine monitoring dashboards, alerting mechanisms, and performance tracking.

requirements.description: AI system incidents and near-misses are tracked and analyzed.
requirements.guidance: Review incident tracking systems, root cause analysis procedures, and lessons learned.

controls.name: Independent Evaluation
controls.description: Conduct independent evaluations and audits of AI systems.

requirements.description: AI systems undergo independent evaluation or audit as appropriate.
requirements.guidance: Review third-party audit reports, independent assessments, and external evaluations.

requirements.description: Results of independent evaluations are documented and addressed.
requirements.guidance: Examine audit findings, remediation plans, and follow-up actions.

requirements.description: Processes are in place to share measurement results with relevant stakeholders.
requirements.guidance: Review reporting procedures, stakeholder communication, and transparency mechanisms.

categories.name: Manage
categories.description: Prioritize and respond to AI risks through risk treatment plans, resource allocation, and monitoring.

controls.name: Risk Prioritization
controls.description: Prioritize AI risks to allocate resources effectively.

requirements.description: AI system risks are prioritized based on assessed likelihood and impact.
requirements.guidance: Review risk prioritization methodology, scoring criteria, and ranking procedures.

requirements.description: Risk prioritization considers context-specific factors and stakeholder input.
requirements.guidance: Examine stakeholder input processes, contextual factors, and prioritization rationale.

requirements.description: Risk prioritization decisions and rationale are documented.
requirements.guidance: Review decision documentation, risk registers, and prioritization records.

controls.name: Risk Treatment
controls.description: Develop and implement risk treatment plans for identified AI risks.

requirements.description: Risk treatment plans are developed for prioritized AI system risks.
requirements.guidance: Review risk treatment strategies, mitigation plans, and control implementations.

requirements.description: Mechanisms are in place to track risk treatment implementation and effectiveness.
requirements.guidance: Examine treatment tracking, effectiveness monitoring, and remediation status.

requirements.description: Post-deployment AI system monitoring plans are developed and implemented.
requirements.guidance: Review monitoring strategies, alerting mechanisms, and ongoing assessment procedures.

requirements.description: Risk treatment decisions are documented and communicated to stakeholders.
requirements.guidance: Examine decision documentation, stakeholder communication, and transparency measures.

controls.name: Resource Allocation
controls.description: Allocate resources commensurate with AI risk levels and treatment needs.

requirements.description: Resources are allocated for AI risk management activities based on risk levels.
requirements.guidance: Review resource allocation decisions, budget documentation, and staffing plans.

requirements.description: AI risk management teams have appropriate expertise and authority.
requirements.guidance: Examine team composition, expertise assessments, and authority documentation.

controls.name: Residual Risk
controls.description: Document and communicate residual risks after treatment implementation.

requirements.description: Residual AI system risks are documented and communicated to decision-makers.
requirements.guidance: Review residual risk documentation, acceptance decisions, and communication records.

requirements.description: Plans are in place to monitor and manage residual risks over time.
requirements.guidance: Examine ongoing monitoring plans, reassessment schedules, and residual risk tracking.

categories.name: Generative AI Risk Profile (AI 600-1)
categories.description: NIST AI 600-1 Generative AI Profile identifies 12 unique risks of generative AI systems requiring specific governance and technical controls beyond the core AI RMF.

controls.name: CBRN Information
controls.description: Chemical, Biological, Radiological, Nuclear: Controls preventing GenAI systems from providing uplift to actors seeking to create or deploy CBRN weapons.

requirements.description: Content filtering for CBRN queries — implement automated detection and blocking of queries seeking dangerous synthesis information or operational guidance for CBRN weapons.
requirements.guidance: Deploy and maintain CBRN-specific content classifiers. Review and update filter coverage regularly against new threat scenarios.

requirements.description: Red-teaming for CBRN scenarios — conduct structured adversarial testing specifically targeting CBRN uplift attempts including indirect and multi-turn elicitation strategies.
requirements.guidance: Engage specialized red teams with domain expertise. Document findings and remediation actions. Conduct testing prior to deployment and on a regular cadence post-deployment.

requirements.description: Output monitoring for dangerous synthesis information — monitor generated outputs for content that could provide meaningful uplift toward CBRN weapon development.
requirements.guidance: Implement real-time output scanning. Establish escalation and incident response procedures for detected CBRN-related outputs.

controls.name: Confabulation (Hallucination)
controls.description: Controls addressing GenAI systems generating false or misleading information presented as factual.

requirements.description: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) for grounding — implement RAG or equivalent grounding mechanisms to anchor outputs to verified information sources for high-stakes use cases.
requirements.guidance: Evaluate RAG implementation quality including retrieval accuracy and source freshness. Document the scope of use cases where RAG is applied.

requirements.description: Confidence scoring — implement and surface confidence or uncertainty estimates to downstream users and systems to signal reliability of generated content.
requirements.guidance: Validate calibration of confidence scores. Ensure scores are surfaced appropriately in user interfaces and APIs.

requirements.description: Citation and source attribution — require the system to cite sources for factual claims and provide mechanisms to verify citations.
requirements.guidance: Test citation accuracy and completeness. Assess whether citations correspond to actual source content.

requirements.description: Human review for high-stakes outputs — mandate human review before acting on GenAI outputs in high-stakes domains such as medical, legal, financial, and safety-critical contexts.
requirements.guidance: Define the inventory of high-stakes use cases. Verify that human review workflows are operational and documented.

requirements.description: Disclaimer requirements for unverified content — display clear disclosures to users when content has not been verified or may be inaccurate.
requirements.guidance: Review disclaimer placement, clarity, and whether users acknowledge limitations before relying on outputs.

controls.name: Data Privacy
controls.description: Controls for GenAI systems that may memorize, reproduce, or infer personal information from training data or prompts.

requirements.description: Training data PII scrubbing — implement automated detection and removal of personally identifiable information from training datasets prior to model training.
requirements.guidance: Review PII detection methodology, coverage, and residual PII testing. Document deidentification techniques applied.

requirements.description: Differential privacy techniques — apply differential privacy or equivalent privacy-preserving mechanisms during training to limit memorization of individual records.
requirements.guidance: Document privacy budget parameters and tradeoffs with model utility. Validate implementation of differential privacy mechanisms.

requirements.description: Membership inference attack testing — conduct testing to assess whether the model memorizes and can reproduce training data in response to adversarial queries.
requirements.guidance: Use established membership inference attack frameworks. Document findings and remediation steps.

requirements.description: Prompt injection monitoring for data exfiltration — monitor for prompt injection patterns that attempt to extract PII or sensitive data from the model or its context window.
requirements.guidance: Review detection rules and alerting for exfiltration-oriented injection patterns. Test detection effectiveness.

requirements.description: Data minimization in prompts — implement controls to prevent unnecessary inclusion of sensitive personal data in prompts sent to GenAI systems.
requirements.guidance: Review prompt construction pipelines for unnecessary PII inclusion. Assess whether data minimization policies are enforced technically.

controls.name: Environmental Impact
controls.description: Controls addressing energy consumption and carbon footprint of large-scale GenAI training and inference.

requirements.description: Energy consumption monitoring — measure and track energy consumption for GenAI training runs and inference workloads.
requirements.guidance: Review energy metering methodologies, data collection, and reporting cadence.

requirements.description: Carbon footprint reporting — calculate and disclose carbon emissions associated with GenAI operations including Scope 2 and relevant Scope 3 emissions.
requirements.guidance: Assess methodology for carbon accounting, use of renewable energy credits, and completeness of Scope 3 considerations.

requirements.description: Efficiency benchmarks per inference — establish and monitor efficiency metrics such as energy per inference or tokens per watt to guide optimization.
requirements.guidance: Review baseline benchmarks, trend monitoring, and optimization initiatives.

requirements.description: Sustainable compute sourcing policy — establish a policy for prioritizing compute infrastructure powered by renewable or low-carbon energy sources.
requirements.guidance: Review policy documentation and evidence of sustainable sourcing in procurement decisions.

requirements.description: Model size optimization for deployment — evaluate and implement model compression, distillation, or quantization techniques to reduce inference footprint.
requirements.guidance: Document optimization techniques applied and their impact on model performance and energy consumption.

controls.name: Human-AI Configuration
controls.description: Controls ensuring appropriate human oversight and preventing over-reliance on GenAI outputs.

requirements.description: Human-in-the-loop for critical decisions — require human review and approval before GenAI outputs are used to drive consequential decisions affecting individuals or operations.
requirements.guidance: Define and document the inventory of critical decision types. Verify that human-in-the-loop controls are enforced in workflows.

requirements.description: Automation bias assessment — assess the degree to which users and operators over-rely on or uncritically accept GenAI outputs, and implement countermeasures.
requirements.guidance: Review user research, usability studies, and any audit findings related to automation bias. Assess interface design choices that promote appropriate skepticism.

requirements.description: Operator override capabilities — ensure operators and users have reliable mechanisms to override, reject, or escalate GenAI outputs.
requirements.guidance: Test override and escalation pathways. Verify they are accessible and effective.

requirements.description: User awareness of AI limitations — communicate system limitations, known failure modes, and appropriate use boundaries to users.
requirements.guidance: Review user-facing documentation, onboarding materials, and in-product disclosures.

requirements.description: Deployment context appropriateness review — assess whether the level of human oversight configured for the system is appropriate for the deployment context and risk level.
requirements.guidance: Examine deployment context risk assessments and alignment between oversight levels and risk classifications.

controls.name: Intellectual Property
controls.description: Controls addressing copyright, patent, and trade secret risks from GenAI training data and outputs.

requirements.description: Training data licensing review — conduct legal review of training data licenses to assess permissibility of use for model training.
requirements.guidance: Review license inventory, legal opinions, and data provenance documentation.

requirements.description: Output copyright screening — implement or evaluate mechanisms to detect when generated outputs may reproduce copyrighted material.
requirements.guidance: Assess output screening tools, coverage, and processes for handling detected reproductions.

requirements.description: IP risk disclosure to users — disclose IP-related limitations and risks to users, including guidance on reviewing outputs for potential copyright issues.
requirements.guidance: Review user-facing disclosures and terms of service regarding IP risk.

requirements.description: Takedown request handling — establish a process for receiving, evaluating, and acting on IP takedown requests related to training data or system outputs.
requirements.guidance: Review takedown request procedures, response timelines, and documented outcomes.

requirements.description: Fair use assessment process — establish a legal process for assessing fair use considerations in training data usage and output reproduction.
requirements.guidance: Examine legal review procedures and documentation of fair use determinations.

controls.name: Obscene/Harmful Content
controls.description: Controls preventing generation of child sexual abuse material (CSAM), non-consensual intimate imagery, and other harmful content.

requirements.description: CSAM detection and filtering — implement PhotoDNA or equivalent hash-matching and classifier-based detection to prevent generation or output of CSAM.
requirements.guidance: Review implementation of CSAM detection technology, coverage, and testing. Verify integration with content moderation pipeline.

requirements.description: Harmful content classifiers — deploy classifiers to detect and block generation of non-consensual intimate imagery, graphic violence, and other harmful content categories.
requirements.guidance: Review classifier taxonomy, accuracy metrics, and threshold settings. Assess coverage of relevant harmful content categories.

requirements.description: Mandatory content moderation — implement mandatory content moderation for all user-facing GenAI outputs with defined escalation procedures.
requirements.guidance: Review moderation pipeline architecture, coverage, and escalation workflows.

requirements.description: Platform-level reporting obligations — ensure compliance with applicable legal reporting obligations for CSAM and other harmful content detected by the system.
requirements.guidance: Review reporting procedures, legal compliance documentation, and evidence of required reports to authorities.

requirements.description: Zero-tolerance policy enforcement — establish and enforce a zero-tolerance policy for CSAM generation with documented technical and procedural controls.
requirements.guidance: Review policy documentation, enforcement mechanisms, and audit evidence.

controls.name: Psychosocial Harms
controls.description: Controls addressing manipulation, addiction, radicalization, and psychological harm from GenAI interactions.

requirements.description: Persuasion and manipulation detection — implement controls to detect and limit outputs that employ manipulative persuasion techniques targeting users.
requirements.guidance: Review detection methodology for manipulative content patterns. Assess coverage of known persuasion and dark pattern techniques.

requirements.description: Engagement addiction pattern monitoring — monitor for system behaviors or output patterns that may foster excessive engagement or dependency.
requirements.guidance: Review metrics for engagement patterns, escalation thresholds, and any interventions implemented.

requirements.description: Crisis intervention protocols — implement protocols to detect user crisis indicators and provide appropriate mental health resources and escalation pathways.
requirements.guidance: Review crisis detection triggers, resource provision procedures, and escalation paths. Test effectiveness in simulated scenarios.

requirements.description: Radicalization content detection — implement detection for outputs that may promote extremist ideologies or facilitate radicalization.
requirements.guidance: Review classifier coverage for extremist content categories. Assess false positive and false negative rates.

requirements.description: Personalization limits for vulnerable users — establish limits on personalization and behavioral targeting for users identified as potentially vulnerable.
requirements.guidance: Review policies for vulnerable user identification and associated personalization restrictions.

controls.name: Security (Cybersecurity Risks from GenAI)
controls.description: Controls addressing how GenAI systems can be exploited to generate malware, phishing content, or attack code.

requirements.description: Code generation security scanning — scan generated code for security vulnerabilities, malicious patterns, and dangerous functionality before delivery to users.
requirements.guidance: Review scanning tool coverage, integration points in the code generation pipeline, and remediation procedures.

requirements.description: Malicious use case detection — implement detection for requests seeking to generate malware, phishing templates, exploit code, or attack tooling.
requirements.guidance: Assess classifier coverage for malicious use case patterns. Review false positive management procedures.

requirements.description: Output filtering for attack signatures — filter outputs for known attack signatures, shellcode patterns, and malicious payload indicators.
requirements.guidance: Review signature coverage and update cadence. Assess integration with threat intelligence feeds.

requirements.description: Responsible disclosure process — establish a responsible disclosure program for security researchers to report misuse capabilities or vulnerabilities.
requirements.guidance: Review disclosure program documentation, response procedures, and evidence of researcher engagement.

requirements.description: Red-teaming for security misuse — conduct structured red-team exercises targeting cybersecurity misuse scenarios including malware generation and attack assistance.
requirements.guidance: Review red-team scope, methodology, findings, and remediation tracking.

controls.name: Value Chain and Component Integration
controls.description: Controls for risks introduced through third-party foundation models, APIs, and AI supply chain components.

requirements.description: Foundation model provenance documentation — document the provenance, training data lineage, and known limitations of all foundation models used in the system.
requirements.guidance: Review model cards, vendor documentation, and provenance records for all integrated foundation models.

requirements.description: Third-party AI vendor security assessment — conduct security assessments of third-party AI vendors and foundation model providers.
requirements.guidance: Review vendor assessment questionnaires, audit reports, and security certifications.

requirements.description: API dependency risk assessment — assess security and reliability risks introduced by dependencies on third-party AI APIs.
requirements.guidance: Review API dependency inventory, risk assessments, and contingency plans for API unavailability.

requirements.description: Model update notification process — establish a process to receive and evaluate notifications of updates, changes, or known issues with integrated third-party models.
requirements.guidance: Review notification procedures, evaluation workflows, and change management records.

requirements.description: Supply chain AI bill of materials (AI-SBOM) — maintain an AI-SBOM documenting all AI components, models, datasets, and third-party services in the system.
requirements.guidance: Review AI-SBOM completeness, update cadence, and integration with risk management processes.

controls.name: AI System Security (Adversarial ML Attacks)
controls.description: Controls against prompt injection, jailbreaking, model inversion, and adversarial attacks specific to GenAI.

requirements.description: Prompt injection detection and sanitization — implement detection and sanitization controls for prompt injection attempts targeting system prompts or privileged instructions.
requirements.guidance: Review injection detection coverage, sanitization techniques, and bypass testing results.

requirements.description: Jailbreak testing in red-teaming — include structured jailbreak attempt scenarios in red-team exercises covering known and novel techniques.
requirements.guidance: Review jailbreak test coverage, methodology, findings, and remediation actions.

requirements.description: Adversarial robustness testing — test model robustness against adversarial inputs designed to cause unexpected or harmful outputs.
requirements.guidance: Review adversarial testing frameworks used, coverage, and documented robustness metrics.

requirements.description: Model inversion attack assessment — assess susceptibility of the model to model inversion attacks that may extract training data or sensitive information.
requirements.guidance: Review model inversion testing methodology and findings. Document mitigations implemented.

requirements.description: Input validation and sandboxing — implement input validation controls and execution sandboxing to limit the impact of adversarial inputs.
requirements.guidance: Review input validation rules, sandboxing architecture, and escape testing results.

controls.name: Data Poisoning
controls.description: Controls preventing malicious manipulation of training data that corrupts model behavior.

requirements.description: Training data integrity validation — implement integrity checks on training data to detect unauthorized modifications, insertions, or deletions.
requirements.guidance: Review integrity validation mechanisms, cryptographic controls, and anomaly detection applied to training datasets.

requirements.description: Data provenance tracking — maintain chain-of-custody records for all training data documenting origin, transformations, and access history.
requirements.guidance: Review provenance documentation systems, completeness, and auditability.

requirements.description: Poisoning detection techniques — apply statistical and ML-based techniques to detect poisoning artifacts in training data or model behavior.
requirements.guidance: Review poisoning detection methodology, tool coverage, and integration into the training pipeline.

requirements.description: Model behavior monitoring post-training — monitor deployed model behavior for anomalies that may indicate successful poisoning attacks.
requirements.guidance: Review behavioral monitoring metrics, alerting thresholds, and incident response procedures.

requirements.description: Training pipeline access controls — implement strict access controls over training infrastructure, data stores, and pipeline components.
requirements.guidance: Review access control policies, least-privilege enforcement, and audit logs for training pipeline components.

controls.name: Prompt Injection
controls.description: Controls specifically addressing direct and indirect prompt injection attacks that manipulate GenAI behavior through malicious inputs.

requirements.description: Input sanitization for system prompt protection — sanitize user inputs to prevent injection of instructions that override or manipulate system prompts.
requirements.guidance: Review sanitization techniques, coverage, and bypass testing results.

requirements.description: Indirect injection detection — implement detection for indirect prompt injection delivered through retrieved documents, URLs, tool outputs, or other external content processed by the model.
requirements.guidance: Review indirect injection detection coverage across all external content ingestion pathways.

requirements.description: Privilege separation in multi-agent systems — enforce privilege separation between agent roles and restrict the ability of lower-trust agents or content to issue instructions to higher-trust system components.
requirements.guidance: Review multi-agent architecture trust boundaries, privilege enforcement, and isolation controls.

requirements.description: Prompt injection test suite — maintain and execute a dedicated prompt injection test suite covering direct, indirect, and multi-turn injection scenarios.
requirements.guidance: Review test suite coverage, update cadence, and integration into CI/CD or release processes.

requirements.description: Output monitoring for injection success indicators — monitor system outputs for behavioral indicators that suggest a prompt injection attack has succeeded.
requirements.guidance: Review output monitoring rules, alerting mechanisms, and incident response procedures for suspected injection success.
